questions.question: It was only when I had finished my homework that I realized I had forgotten to buy milk.
options: I had forgotten to buy milk only after I'd finished my homework.
Only after finishing my homework did I remember to buy milk.
I forgot to buy milk until I had finished my homework.
It wasn't until after I finished my homework that I remembered the milk.
questions.answer: Only after finishing my homework did I remember to buy milk.

questions.question: Unless you're willing to pay a significant fee, it's unlikely that your manuscript will be published.
options: If you don't want to pay a significant fee, then it's unlikely that your manuscript will be published.
You won't get your manuscript published unless you're prepared to pay a lot of money.
Unless you're prepared to spend a fortune on publishing costs, your work is unlikely to see the light of day.
It's not possible for your manuscript to be published if you don't have enough money.
questions.answer: You won't get your manuscript published unless you're prepared to pay a lot of money.

questions.question: By the time I arrived at the party, most of the guests had already left.
options: When I got to the party, it was still early and people were just starting to arrive.
Most of the guests had gone home by the time I arrived at the party.
It wasn't until after I'd been at the party for a while that most of the guests started to leave.
By the time I arrived at the party, only a few people were still there.
questions.answer: Most of the guests had already left by the time I arrived at the party.

questions.question: It is essential that all employees adhere to the company's strict code of conduct.
options: All employees must follow the company's rules very carefully.
The company expects its staff to behave in a way that reflects well on the organization.
Employees are required to comply with the company's regulations at all times.
It is crucial for employees to respect the company's policies and procedures.
questions.answer: All employees must follow the company's rules very carefully.

questions.question: I would rather be a failure in my own business than a success in someone else's.
options: It would be better for me to fail in my own venture than succeed in someone else's.
I'd prefer to be a failure in my own company than a success in someone else's.
Being a failure in your own business is worse than being a success in someone else's.
In my opinion, it's more important to be successful in your own business than in someone else's.
questions.answer: It would be better for me to fail in my own venture than succeed in someone else's.
